passages.text: A song of ascents. Of David.
passages.sermon:
This is a song.
David wrote this song.
People sing this song when they go up to worship God.

passages.text: I was glad when they said to me, “Let us go to the house of the LORD.”
passages.sermon:
David wrote this song of ascents.
David felt joy.
People spoke to David.
They said, “Let us go to the house of the LORD.”
David was glad when he heard this.
passages.original: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד שָׂ֭מַחְתִּי בְּאֹמְרִ֣ים לִ֑י בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֣ה נֵלֵֽךְ׃

passages.text: Our feet are standing in your gates, O Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this song for people traveling to Jerusalem.
We are now in Jerusalem.
We are standing inside your gates, Jerusalem.
Our feet are here in your city.

passages.text: Jerusalem is built up as a city united together, where the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, as a testimony for Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Jerusalem is a city.
People have built Jerusalem up.
Jerusalem is united together.
The tribes go up to Jerusalem.
These tribes belong to the LORD.
The tribes go up as a testimony for Israel.
The tribes go up to give thanks to the name of the LORD.
passages.original: יְרוּשָׁלִַ֥ם הַבְּנוּיָ֑ה כְּ֝עִ֗יר שֶׁחֻבְּרָה־ לָּ֥הּ יַחְדָּֽו׃ שֶׁשָּׁ֨ם עָל֪וּ שְׁבָטִ֡ים שִׁבְטֵי־ יָ֭הּ עֵד֣וּת לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְ֝הֹד֗וֹת לְשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: For there the thrones of judgment stand, the thrones of the house of David.
passages.sermon:
Jerusalem is the city where the thrones of judgment stand.
These thrones belong to the house of David.
Judges sit on these thrones and make decisions.
The house of David rules from these thrones in Jerusalem.
passages.original: כִּ֤י שָׁ֨מָּה׀ יָשְׁב֣וּ כִסְא֣וֹת לְמִשְׁפָּ֑ט כִּ֝סְא֗וֹת לְבֵ֣ית דָּוִֽיד׃

passages.text: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: “May those who love you prosper.
passages.sermon:
Jerusalem is a city.
Jerusalem is important to God.
Pray for Jerusalem’s peace.
Ask God to give peace to Jerusalem.
Those who love Jerusalem will prosper.
God will bless the people who care for Jerusalem.

passages.text: May there be peace within your walls, and prosperity inside your fortresses.”
passages.sermon:
This psalm is a prayer for Jerusalem.
Jerusalem is the city where the thrones of judgment stand.
The house of David rules there.
I pray for Jerusalem.
May there be peace inside your walls.
May there be prosperity inside your fortresses.

passages.text: For the sake of my brothers and friends, I will say, “Peace be within you.”
passages.sermon: I speak for the good of my brothers.\r\nI speak for the good of my friends.\r\nI say, “Peace be within you.”
passages.original: לְ֭מַעַן אַחַ֣י וְרֵעָ֑י אֲדַבְּרָה־ נָּ֖א שָׁל֣וֹם בָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your prosperity.
passages.sermon:
The house of the LORD is God's temple.
God is our God.
I will seek good for you.
I do this for the sake of God's house.
passages.original: לְ֭מַעַן בֵּית־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ אֲבַקְשָׁ֖ה ט֣וֹב לָֽךְ׃
